changes.now: Fury rallies the team with the cards from Coulson's jacket.
changes.proposed: Fury rallies the team with the cards he says were in Coulson's jacket.
changes.evidence: In The Avengers (2012) the cards were not in Coulson's jacket: Maria Hill tells Fury 'They were in Coulson's locker. Not in his jacket.' Fury: 'They needed the push.' Fandom: Fury took the cards out of Coulson's locker and smeared them in his blood. The title (Fury's claim) stays; the hint states the claim as fact.
